title: Threat Intelligence: fix video loading (TTFB and 310 MB homepage)
description: Homepage transfers ~310 MB: edition-overview video fetched 3x, article videos ~9 MB each, direct from S3, no CDN, no lazy loading. Goal: few MB on load. Scope: lazy/poster/preload=none, dedupe fetches, encode plan, CloudFront design (unexecuted change set). PRs unmerged. (Epic because initiative can only hold epics.)

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/202 (branch fix/PPY-79e668-reader-video-loading, open, unmerged, CI pending at time of writing). Before (prod, headless Chrome, cache off): 97 requests, 52 video requests, 9.4 MB total (310 MB not reproduced as wire bytes), 12 video files each fetched 3-8x, TTFB 0.5-1.3 s (HTML is no-store, redirect 307 from /). Root causes: source in SSR, key remount at hydration, dark-then-light themed file swap, preload=metadata on all 7, moov-last MP4s, per-fetch distinct presigned S3 URLs. After (harness of old vs new component with the 7 real videos): 9 requests, 6 video requests, 2.1 MB, 2 files. Encode plan: faststart + AAC 96k + webp poster, 153 MB to ~119 MB (script in PR, nothing uploaded). CloudFront design in infra/edge/threat-intelligence-media.yaml: validated, NOT created or executed, needs bucket policy statement + Ryan approval. Unverified: full TI Next build with the fix (needs package release and pin bump).
